Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 918-920 West Eastwood Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 6,696 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to permit two (2) dwelling units within the
basement of the existing three-story six (6) dwelling unit residential
building. When complete, the building will contain a total of eight (8)
dwelling units. The height and footprint of the existing building will remain
without change. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will
be supported by eight (8) off-street parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Secs, 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1003-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking ratio
for a Transit Served Location to 100% (eight (8) parking spaces for eight
(8) residential units), reduce the combined side setback from the required
10.8 ft to 3.7 ft., with the west and east side setback to remain at 1.4 ft. and
2.3 ft., respectively, and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the
Chicago Zoning code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 9,330 square feet (1.39 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 837 square feet per D.U.
(8 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 8 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Sheridan Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
required number of off-street parking spaces from four (4) parking spaces (50%) to
eight (8) parking spaces (100%).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 9.8 feet (existing to remain)
db, Side Setbacks:
East Side: 2.3 feet (existing to remain)
West Side: 1.4 feet (existing to remain)
G Rear Setback: 44,1 feet (existing to remain)

(E) Building Height: 33 feet-4 inches
